evidence_required: Slowdown arithmetic; ranked hypothesis table; evidence plan with commands; root-cause arithmetic; fix and validation plan; one acceptance-checklist line.

marking.criterion: Slowdown 29.9 % computed, clock ratio 0.598, and the synchronous-job explanation of why it is smaller than the clock loss
At least three hypotheses ranked with reasons (PSU cording first, failed PSUs, BMC power policy, PDU fault), thermal rejected
Evidence plan with real read-only commands or data sources (ipmitool sdr, Redfish PowerSupplies, PDU outlet map, dcmi power limit)
Root-cause arithmetic (2 x 3.0 = 6.0 kW against about 7.99 kW DC sustained; braked rack at most about 25.5 kW, consistent with 24.1 kW)
Safe fix (drain, re-cord 3A/3B under change control), validation without a maintenance window, and the acceptance-checklist line

title: The maintenance-window slowdown
